name: Write an SEO content brief from live Google results with one AI agent and looot into Notion

parameters.content:
## SEO content brief from the pages that rank today

### How it works
1. You fill in a form with a keyword and a country.
2. One AI agent reads Google's top results and autocomplete suggestions for the keyword through looot, then reads the top 3 to 5 ranking pages.
3. It writes a brief: search intent, a title, an H2 outline, questions to answer, related keywords, the length of the ranking pages and what they all miss.
4. The brief becomes a Notion page.

One looot credential replaces the DataForSEO and SerpAPI accounts this flow usually needs.

**Cost per brief**, from looot's public catalog on 2026-10-31: Google results $0.0009 to $0.001, autocomplete $0.00099, a page read from $0.0002. About $0.004 per brief. Each call is capped at $0.03 and the agent at 15 steps, so a brief can never cost more than $0.45. Model tokens are billed by OpenAI.

### Setup
- Needs the verified community node **n8n-nodes-looot** (built against 0.1.4): Settings > Community nodes > Install, search `looot`. [Install guide](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/verified-install/)
- looot: sign up at [looot.ai](https://looot.ai), top up (from $5), create an agent token under Settings > Agent tokens, then add a **looot API** credential in n8n.
- OpenAI and Notion credentials. A Notion database with a Name title property; set its ID in **Save to Notion**.
- Self-hosted n8n: set `N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_ALLOW_TOOL_USAGE=true` so the agent can use the looot node as a tool.

### Customization
Add your brand voice and product to the system message. Swap Notion for Google Docs.

parameters.formDescription: Reads today's Google results for a keyword and writes a brief in Notion.

options.systemMessage:
You write SEO content briefs.
1. job:google.serp.organic with {"query": "<keyword>", "location": "<country>"}.
2. job:google.keywords.suggestions with {"query": "<keyword>"}.
3. Read the top 3 to 5 organic pages with job:web.scrape.markdown.
Write the brief in plain text under 5,000 characters: search intent, a title, an H2 outline, questions to answer, related keywords, the rough word count of the ranking pages, what they all miss, and the URLs you read.

parameters.toolDescription:
Runs one looot data call and returns the run: status, result and actualCost. Every call is capped. Use only these ids and inputs:
- job:google.serp.organic, input {"query": "...", "location": "United States"}: Google organic results.
- job:google.keywords.suggestions, input {"query": "..."}: Google autocomplete suggestions.
- job:web.scrape.markdown, input {"url": "https://..."}: one page as text.
